scope: Read-only source review of main/renderer/live controls and save boundary; separate shipped bridge tests and isolated real HTTP sessions. No native browser or visual-quality claims by this reviewer.

frontend.scope: Shipped ES bridge with independent network gates; coordinate mapping, public projection, receiver binding, stale response prevention, duplicate confirmation, reject/no-retry, Lab normalization.

http.scope: Actual ES bridge -> HTTP -> reviewed RebirthSession purchase, duplicate prevention, invalid movement, time advance, Lab/view normalization, exact journal restore; static JSON/binary MIME, traversal/symlink, Host/Origin boundaries and legacy availability.

live_scheduler.scope: Actual shipped Live functions with independent timer and accepted-save gates. Pause/resume revival, stale callback, pending pause, one-minute arguments, repeated toggles, busy/navigation/conversation/modal/visual-tail guards and failed save without POST retry.

final_frontend_suite.scope: Fresh run after frozen-diagnostics fix. Contains the 17 bridge, 12 Live, renderer and 2 new measurement checks alongside prior-client regressions. Not a native-browser performance result.

reviewed_behaviors: Renderer and navigation retain simulator x/y units; .02 metres per unit and origin(800,415) are a presentation mapping only.
Camera-relative movement transforms input once; short accepted steps remain authoritative and interpolated separately.
Conversation/proposal epochs suppress stale replies; confirmation sends only server proposal/interpretation IDs and never client money or goods.
Public projection rejects operator snapshots; shared legacy Lab responses normalize back to game mode before entity presentation.
An accepted mutation is never retried automatically. Failed persistence remains a server rollback concern, preserved by the existing session commit boundary.

Live version-controls each timer chain and schedules only after its previous request resolves; the old pause/resume chain cannot revive. It checks movement, remaining animation, dialogs, conversation and pending API work.
New navigation, conversations, dialogs, explicit skips and page hiding stop future live timers; a tick already in flight may complete and remains part of the accepted history.

J toggles the journal, rejected repeated held keys cannot restart cancelled movement, interior exit/door labels remain available, and final action review shows server quoted cost/consequence/unavailability.
Launcher uses a separate default immersion journal and explicitly disables paid providers. The original Rebirth launcher/client remain runnable.
resolved_findings: Initial renderer snap called nonexistent actor.setAt; root corrected the render helper call.
Static JSON asset bytes were JSON-serialized, causing 400 manifest loads; root corrected binary/text response handling and the real HTTP regression now passes.
Browser fetch was invoked with a bridge receiver; default fetch is now explicitly bound to the browser global, with an independent receiver regression.
Opening legacy World Lab could make a subsequent accepted 3D action return operator state; bridge now obtains a public game response before accepting it, without repeating the action.
Generic settled animation matching could celebrate an unfulfilled legacy delivery; root now uses explicit positive receipt categories.

Pause/Live during a pending tick could revive an old scheduling chain, increasing pending timers from one to two. Root added live-session generation checks and single-timer ownership. The independent gated regression now retains exactly one fresh-session timer after the old response resolves.

Frozen diagnostics compared an absent input ID with an undefined token, then dereferenced null after a valid move. Root added explicit frozen/pending/token guards; the two new shipped-class regressions pass in the fresh full frontend run.
remaining_limits: This review does not establish native game feel, model appearance, WebGL performance, physical-device behavior, or human enjoyment; root performs actual browser QA separately.
World navigation remains the existing authoritative floor/portal geometry; renderer decoration must not imply additional traversable space or unsupported consequential collisions.
A network failure after server acceptance can require a state reload; economic POSTs are intentionally not retried because receipt delivery is not evidence of nonacceptance.
Live pause/cancellation does not undo an already accepted or in-flight world-minute request.

live_race_verification.method: Shipped functions executed in a VM with independent timer/API gates, not source-string assertions.
